headline: On last trading session, Indian stock market extended its four-week rally to hit nine-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying supported Indian equities, pushing Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs.
Banking, auto, and IT stocks led recovery efforts during recent trading sessions.
Global AI sell-offs and Fed rate hike signals created market volatility in early trade.
Reliance Brands reported revenue growth and narrowing losses for FY26.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty extended their four-week rally on strong institutional inflows.
Reliance Brands FY26 revenue rose 3.8% to ₹3,390.9 crore, narrowing loss to ₹137 crore.
Markets experienced volatility earlier in the week due to global AI tech sell-offs.
Gold dropped to its lowest level of 2026 alongside weakness in global equities.
summary: Indian benchmark indices extended their four-week rally to touch nine-month highs on strong FII inflows. Gains in banking, auto, and IT stocks helped offset volatility triggered by global AI tech sell-offs and US rate hike concerns. The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 23 November.
